author: Kris Ploch
name: MrPloch application (Spectre console + EF Core data layer)

siblingsRoot.description: Relative path (with a trailing backslash) from the generated repository root to the parent folder that holds the side-by-side ploch-* sibling repositories. The default assumes the new repo is cloned directly beside ploch-common, ploch-data, ploch-commandline and mrploch-development.

skipRestore.description: Skip the automatic 'dotnet restore' run after the project is created.

referenceStyle.description: How the generated repository references the Ploch libraries by default. Either style can still be flipped at build time with -p:UsePlochProjectReferences=true|false.

choices.description: Relative ProjectReferences to the side-by-side ploch-* sibling repository clones (local cross-repo development).

PackageReferences restored from the MrPloch GitHub Packages feed (requires the MRPLOCH_GITHUB_PACKAGES_TOKEN environment variable). Note: Ploch.CommandLine.Spectre is not yet published, so the ConsoleApp project always references the ploch-commandline sibling clone.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
